decisions.statement: An element gives a sense of itself to whoever holds an affinity of it.
An element names the acts an affinity of it sweetens.
An element names the one pool a rough absorption of it takes its cost from.
Heat, flame and ember are one element, named ember wherever a mechanic names it.
Cold is no element a climber absorbs.

definition: the six elements an affinity is of, each with its sense, its reach and its cost
